locator: Great Vault and Voidcore pre-season details
faithful_paraphrase: The first Season 2 World-row Great Vault is capped at Champion 3/6; later World-row Vaults can reach Hero 1/6, and Voidcore bonus rolls become available in the second week rather than the first.
Season 2 gear uses Mistcrests as its main upgrade currency and standard tracks progress from 1/6 to 6/6.
Current players discuss banking bonus rolls and the possibility of duplicate rewards, supporting the need to keep selection, upgrade, and bonus-roll behavior separate.
